text_en: Right, we're inside now.
It seems to be a kind of laboratory...
What is Baydral up to?
Chief! We should hurry!
Yes... Human, this is for you.
It'll allow you to move around underwater without drowning. Don't bad, right?
You're practically Fise now.
Chief, I have a question.
Yes, Baiyu?
Why have we made them take us all the way here if we haven't come across any underwater areas?
Baiyu... Please...
No, seriously. What need was there for them to carry us? We can walk, too.
Baiyu, there's a braj behind you!
I told you it'd be useful. Onwards, we can carry on now.
I'll try to find you later.
Good luck!
Got it!
Unfortunately, it looks like I still can't reach your position.
It's clear we'll need to continue on separate paths for a little while longer.
Good luck, soldier!
That floodgate doesn't have a card reader... Will we be able to open it?
Baiyu, let the important people speak.
(Why don't you just talk to yourself?)
I was referring to the soldierman here.
What do you think? It looks like that capsule contains something with several connections. Perhaps if we break it, it'll cause a system failure in the door.
Break things... Seriously, chief?
Go on, try it.
Oh, bladderwrack! It didn't work...
Wait, chief. You look different. And those hydrobubbles have appeared.
I was just about to mention that, of course.
Mister soldierman, you feel different, right? Try using that energy on the hydrobubbles. We'll find another way.
Come on Baiyu, don't linger.
HA! I knew I'd find the toy first.
Sorry, sister, I don't plan on sharing it with you.
Damn it!
I knew you wouldn't tell me! Selfish as usual!
Always ruining my fun. I might just be tired of having a sister. You'll be next.
How dare you!
If you hadn't been so meddling...
I wasn't going to let you go alone...
This place doesn't feel right...
Chief, it appears to be their main laboratory. Surely if we look at their research...
Tone down the chitchat, Baiyu. I say we should take a peak at Baydral's studies.
Chief, there are all sorts of things here, and all of it is beyond insanity.
Focus on what matters: the curse of the braj.
But our problem is nothing compared to his other plans.
Baiyu, what are you talking about?
Have you seen those murals? It look like he's trying to hybridise saltwater and freshwater Fise.
I must say, it does look a bit sinister...
Is that Hafin Dam?
What was that?
Is it Baydral? We've been to every part of his laboratory and he hasn't turned up anywhere.
Mister soldierman... Would you mind taking a look?
Shouldn't we go with him?
I think figuring out what's going on here is more important right now.
Don't take your eye off those manuscripts.
So, please, if it's Baydral, tell us.
Meddlesome cretins!
You should stay in that beloved city of yours... While you still can...
Did you think we Fise would spend the rest of our existence in a world like this?
You're just an naive as I was in the past, but you'd best start forgetting about your feeble structures. Now it'll be you who will have to adapt to my world.
Because soon there will be nothing but ruins under the raging storm of my revenge!
Muahahahaha...
Hello again, soldier.
I was trying to help our friends find what they were looking for.
But I don't understand a word of these writing, to tell you the truth...
Of course, they're in Fise.
It was Baydral, right?
He was there...
Really? Will he help us? Where is here?
Baiyu, I don't think he's there anymore.
Really?
Seriously?
I've ended up behind again. I knew I was taking too long.
Well, I can't complain. It's been exciting, to be honest.
What will you do now without that scientist of yours?
Chief?
We have no other choice, Baiyu. We'll stay here to find the cure for the braj and we'll take it to the Land of the Waterfalls.
I suppose this is “goodbye”, then. Without Baydral, Hafin City is saved. The earthquakes have stopped and the dam will no longer burst.
Will you be alright here?

We spent so long thinking we were cursed. Once we arrived here, we discovered that Baydral, a legend in our world, had become twisted over the years, a recluse in this place, and that his “magic” was, in reality, science that turned us into horrible monsters.
It's not what we expected, but we've learnt a lot.
We'll stay here for a while and then Baiyu will take all these discoveries to our home.
Of course I will...
Thank you for everything. You Humans aren't so bad.
Thank you both.
Well, thank you all, I'm feeling more capable by the minute. Take care.
Hey soldier, how about a race to Hafin? We've got good news to deliver!
I'm sorry, it's not safe to enter Hafin's sewers due to the large number of monsters we've recently discovered there. Please be patient while we investigate.
